resources.title: Human Behavioral Biology
resources.creator: Robert Sapolsky
resources.subject: Biology
resources.description: A full university lecture series: a larger commitment than an entry point.

resources.title: Feeling Good: The New Mood Therapy
resources.creator: David D. Burns
resources.subject: Psychology
resources.description:
Written for independent use by general readers, with practical exercises rather than assumed university training.

Study focus: Explain one idea about thoughts and mood from the book using your own example. Identify a claim, the evidence Burns gives for it, and a question you still have.

resources.title: Why We Get Mad
resources.creator: Ryan Martin
resources.subject: Psychology
resources.description:
An accessible book for general readers about understanding anger.

Study focus: Explain the account of anger presented by Martin. Connect two ideas from the book to an example and distinguish the author's claims from your own interpretation.

resources.title: Why We Sleep: A Critical Review
resources.creator: Alexey Guzey
resources.subject: Psychology
resources.description:
A standalone article for general readers. Following its cited studies can become extra practice.

Study focus: Choose one criticism in Guzey's article. Trace the cited evidence, explain the claim and counterclaim in your own words, and note what remains uncertain.

resources.title: Alexey Guzey on sleep: Put this guy on Rogan and give him a Ted talk.
resources.creator: Andrew Gelman
resources.subject: Psychology
resources.description:
A short discussion for general readers that introduces the arguments it examines without requiring prior study.

Study focus: Explain Guzey's analogy between sleep and hunger, then compare it with Gelman's objections and his opportunity-cost argument. Separate analogy and personal experience from empirical evidence, and describe what evidence would help assess one disputed claim.

resources.title: The Great Psychotherapy Debate
resources.creator: Bruce E. Wampold and Zac E. Imel
resources.subject: Psychology
resources.description:
A research-focused comparison of explanations for psychotherapy outcomes.

Study focus: Compare two accounts of psychotherapy outcomes discussed in the book. Explain the supporting evidence, its limitations, and what would change your mind.

resources.title: Motivational Interviewing: Helping People Change and Grow (4th ed.)
resources.creator: William R. Miller and Stephen Rollnick
resources.subject: Psychology
resources.description:
A practitioner guide and course text, beyond a general-reader entry point.

Study focus: Explain an idea about conversations around change from the fourth edition. Use your own example, cite the relevant passages, and identify a question to revisit.
